# Summary: BGGM and DAG integration visulization
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 0. Setup & global configuration
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(networktools) 
library(tibble)
library(ggalluvial)
library(bnlearn) # required for the RDS objects

# Path configuration
out_dir     <- out_fig_dir
out_dir_dag <- file.path(out_fig_dir)

if(!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE)

# DAG threshold (must match the Step 3 plotting)

DAG_THRESHOLD <- 0.70  

models <- c("Mental_Health", "Physical_Health", "Social_Health")

# --- Colour scheme ---
my_colors <- c(
  "Environment"     = "#AEC7E8",  
  "Lifestyle"       = "#98DF8A",  
  "Mental_Health"   = "#D8BFD8",  
  "Physical_Health" = "#FFBB78",  
  "Social_Health"   = "#FFB6C1"   
)


heatmap_neg <- "#CD5C5C" 
heatmap_mid <- "white"   
heatmap_pos <- "#2E8B57"


# ==============================================================================
# 🎯 Figure 3 Combined: Shared Y-Axis + Dual Bridge Asterisks
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(networktools)
library(tibble)
library(bnlearn)
library(patchwork)
library(scales) 


# Asterisk colours
color_env_bridge <- "#800080" # purple (Environment)
color_health_bridge <- "#0000FF" # blue (Health)

message("\n========== Generating Figure 3 (dual asterisks) ==========")

# --- Step 1: Gather data and compute bridge centrality ---
list_edges <- list()
all_y_nodes <- c() 

for (model_label in models) {

# A. Read BGGM (auto-detect separator)
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) {
      message(paste0("Resid file not found, trying the NPN file..."))
    bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  }
  
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next

  first_line <- readLines(bggm_file, n = 1)
  
  raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, check.names = FALSE)
  
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) {
    message(paste0("   CSV format looks wrong (<=1 column), trying semicolon (;)..."))
    raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, sep = ";", check.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) {
    message(paste0("   still unresolved, trying tab (\t)..."))
    raw_data <- read.table(bggm_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
  }

  # 5. Handle row names
  if (ncol(raw_data) > 1) {
    rownames(raw_data) <- raw_data[, 1]
    adj_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data[, -1])
  } else {
    message("   Serious error: could not parse data columns; check the CSV separator.")
    message(paste0("   first line: ", first_line))
    next
  }

  
  # B. Bridge EI computation
  node_names <- colnames(adj_mat)
  communities_vec <- case_when(grepl("^E", node_names) ~ "Environment", grepl("^L", node_names) ~ "Lifestyle", TRUE ~ "Health")
  
  bridge_map <- tryCatch({
    bridge_res <- networktools::bridge(adj_mat, communities = communities_vec, useCommunities = "all", directed = FALSE)
    df_bridge <- data.frame(Node = node_names, Bridge_EI = bridge_res$`Bridge Expected Influence (1-step)`)
    
    # keep the top 20%
    threshold <- quantile(df_bridge$Bridge_EI, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) 
    setNames((df_bridge$Bridge_EI >= threshold) & (df_bridge$Bridge_EI > 0), df_bridge$Node)
    
  }, error = function(e) setNames(rep(FALSE, length(node_names)), node_names))
  
  # C. Read the DAG
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  dag_keys <- character()
  dag_status <- "not found / failed to load"
  
  if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
    str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
    avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = DAG_THRESHOLD)
    dag_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
    if(nrow(dag_arcs) > 0) {
        # build safe keys
        dag_keys <- paste0(make.names(dag_arcs$from), "->", make.names(dag_arcs$to))
        dag_status <- paste0("loaded (edges: ", nrow(dag_arcs), ")")
    } else {
        dag_status <- "loaded but no edges (threshold too high?)"
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Data integrity check (diagnostic)
  # ============================================================
  message(paste0("\n--------------------------------------------------"))
  message(paste0("Checking model: [", model_label, "]"))
  message(paste0("   1. BGGM matrix: ", nrow(adj_mat), " rows x ", ncol(adj_mat), " cols"))
  message(paste0("   2. sample variable names: ", paste(head(node_names, 3), collapse=", ")))
  message(paste0("   3. DAG status: ", dag_status))
  
  if(length(dag_keys) > 0) {
      message(paste0("   4. sample DAG keys (make.names):"))
      message(paste0("      -> ", head(dag_keys, 2)))
  }
  message(paste0("--------------------------------------------------\n"))
  # ============================================================

  
# D. Build the data (direct matrix indexing)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ensure it is a matrix
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(adj_mat)
  
  indices <- which(adj_mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(indices) > 0) {
    edges_df <- data.frame(
      V1_str = rownames(adj_mat)[indices[, 1]],
      V2_str = colnames(adj_mat)[indices[, 2]],
      Freq   = adj_mat[indices],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    edges_df <- data.frame(V1_str=character(), V2_str=character(), Freq=numeric())
  }

  edges_df <- edges_df %>% 
    mutate(
      Type_From = case_when(grepl("^E", .data$V1_str) ~ "E", grepl("^L", .data$V1_str) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H"),
      Type_To   = case_when(grepl("^E", .data$V2_str) ~ "E", grepl("^L", .data$V2_str) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H")
    ) %>%
    filter((Type_From == "E" & Type_To == "H") | (Type_From == "H" & Type_To == "E")) %>%
    mutate(
      Source = ifelse(Type_From == "E", V1_str, V2_str),
      Target = ifelse(Type_To == "H", V2_str, V1_str),
      
      Is_Env_Bridge = bridge_map[Source],
      Is_Health_Bridge = bridge_map[Target],

      Expected_Key = paste0(make.names(Source), "->", make.names(Target)),
      Reverse_Key  = paste0(make.names(Target), "->", make.names(Source)),
  
      Direction_Type = case_when(
        Expected_Key %in% dag_keys ~ "Expected (E->H)", 
        Reverse_Key %in% dag_keys ~ "Reverse (H->E)", 
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  
  if (nrow(edges_df) > 0) {
    list_edges[[model_label]] <- edges_df
    all_y_nodes <- c(all_y_nodes, unique(edges_df$Source)) 
  }
}

unified_y_levels <- sort(unique(all_y_nodes))

# --- Step 2: Plot ---
plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  model_label <- models[i]
  if(is.null(list_edges[[model_label]])) next
  df_curr <- list_edges[[model_label]]
  clean_title <- gsub("_", " ", model_label)
  show_y_axis <- (i == 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_curr, aes(x = Target, y = Source)) + 
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    
    # 1. Heatmap
    geom_tile(aes(fill = Freq), color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) + 
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = heatmap_neg, mid = heatmap_mid, high = heatmap_pos, 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.1, 0.1), oob = scales::squish, name = "Partial Correlation") +
    
    # 2. Values
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Freq)), size = 2.8, color = "black", fontface = "bold", position = position_nudge(y = -0.15)) +
    
    # 3. Environment asterisk (top-left, purple)
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Env_Bridge), 
              label = "*", color = color_env_bridge, size = 6, fontface = "bold",
              position = position_nudge(x = -0.3, y = 0.25)) +
    
    # 4. Health asterisk (top-right, blue)
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Health_Bridge), 
              label = "*", color = color_health_bridge, size = 6, fontface = "bold",
              position = position_nudge(x = 0.3, y = 0.25)) +
    
    # 5. Direction marker
    geom_point(aes(shape = Direction_Type), color = "black", size = 3, na.rm = TRUE, position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Direction_Type, color = Direction_Type), size = 2, na.rm = TRUE, position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Expected (E->H)" = 19, "Reverse (H->E)" = 17)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Expected (E->H)" = "#FFD700", "Reverse (H->E)" = "#CD5C5C")) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = unified_y_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 9, color = "black") else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 10, face="bold") else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = if(show_y_axis) element_line() else element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    ) +
    labs(title = clean_title, x = NULL, y = if(show_y_axis) "Environmental Factors" else NULL)
  
  plot_list[[model_label]] <- p
}

# --- Step 3: Assemble panels ---
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3: Direct Pathways across Health Domains (Dual Bridge Markers)",
      subtitle = paste0("Note: Top-Left Purple '*' = Environment Bridge; Top-Right Blue '*' = Health Bridge.\n", "Color range [-0.1, 0.1]. Shapes indicate DAG direction."),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30")
      )
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure3_Combined_DualStars.pdf"), combined_plot, width = 18, height = 7)
  print(combined_plot)
  message("Figure 3 (dual stars) complete.")
  
} else {
  message("No data.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# Refined Figure 3: bubble matrix (red/green)
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(networktools)

message("\n========== Generating the red/green bubble matrix ==========")

# --- 1. Paths and configuration ---
source_dir <- out_fig_dir
save_dir   <- out_fig_dir
if(!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

models <- c("Mental_Health", "Physical_Health", "Social_Health")
color_env_bridge <- "#800080" 
color_health_bridge <- "#0000FF"

# Colour scheme
color_pos <- "#228B22"  # forest green (positive)
color_neg <- "#EE2C2C"  # firebrick red (negative)
color_mid <- "#F7F7F7"  # very light grey

plot_list <- list()

# --- 2. Loop ---
for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  model_label <- models[i]
  
  # A. Read data
  bggm_file <- file.path(source_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) bggm_file <- here::here("plot", paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next
  raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) <= 1) raw_data <- read.csv(bggm_file, sep = ";", check.names = FALSE)
  if (ncol(raw_data) > 1) { rownames(raw_data) <- raw_data[, 1]; adj_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data[, -1]) } else next

  # B. Compute bridge centrality
  node_names <- colnames(adj_mat)
  communities_vec <- case_when(grepl("^E", node_names) ~ "Environment", grepl("^L", node_names) ~ "Lifestyle", TRUE ~ "Health")
  bridge_map <- tryCatch({
    bridge_res <- networktools::bridge(adj_mat, communities = communities_vec, useCommunities = "all", directed = FALSE)
    df_bridge <- data.frame(Node = node_names, Bridge_EI = bridge_res$`Bridge Expected Influence (1-step)`)
    threshold <- quantile(df_bridge$Bridge_EI, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) 
    setNames((df_bridge$Bridge_EI >= threshold) & (df_bridge$Bridge_EI > 0), df_bridge$Node)
  }, error = function(e) setNames(rep(FALSE, length(node_names)), node_names))

  # C. Extract edge data
  indices <- which(adj_mat != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if(nrow(indices) == 0) next
  df_curr <- data.frame(Source = rownames(adj_mat)[indices[, 1]], Target = colnames(adj_mat)[indices[, 2]], Freq = adj_mat[indices], stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(Type_From = case_when(grepl("^E", Source) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Source) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H"),
           Type_To   = case_when(grepl("^E", Target) ~ "E", grepl("^L", Target) ~ "L", TRUE ~ "H")) %>%
    filter((Type_From == "E" & Type_To == "H") | (Type_From == "H" & Type_To == "E")) %>%
    mutate(Real_Source = ifelse(Type_From == "E", Source, Target), Real_Target = ifelse(Type_To == "H", Target, Source),
           Is_Env_Bridge = bridge_map[Real_Source], Is_Health_Bridge = bridge_map[Real_Target]) %>%
    dplyr::select(Source = Real_Source, Target = Real_Target, Freq, Is_Env_Bridge, Is_Health_Bridge)

  if(nrow(df_curr) == 0) next
  
  # D. Plot (bubble plot)
  clean_title <- gsub("_", " ", model_label)
  show_y_axis <- (i == 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_curr, aes(x = Target, y = Source)) + 
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    geom_tile(fill = NA, color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = abs(Freq), fill = Freq), shape = 21, color = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(6, 18), limits = c(0, 0.5), guide = "none") + 
    
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = color_neg, mid = color_mid, high = color_pos, 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.25, 0.25), oob = scales::squish, 
                         name = "Partial Correlation") +
    
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Freq)), size = 3, fontface = "bold", 
              color = ifelse(abs(df_curr$Freq) > 0.15, "white", "black")) +
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Env_Bridge), label = "★", color = color_env_bridge, size = 5, vjust = 0.5, position = position_nudge(x = -0.35, y = 0.35)) +
    geom_text(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Health_Bridge), label = "★", color = color_health_bridge, size = 5, vjust = 0.5, position = position_nudge(x = 0.35, y = 0.35)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold") else element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8), legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = clean_title)
  
  plot_list[[model_label]] <- p
}

# --- 3. Assemble and save ---
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3: Bilateral Relationships (Bubble Matrix)",
      subtitle = "Bubble size = Magnitude; Color = Sign (Green = Positive, Red = Negative); ★ = Top 20% Bridge Node",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
    )
  out_pdf <- file.path(save_dir, "Figure3_Combined_BubbleStyle_GreenRed.pdf")
  ggsave(out_pdf, combined_plot, width = 18, height = 7)
  message(paste("Red/green bubble plot saved to:", out_pdf))
  print(combined_plot)
} else {
  message("No figure produced; check the data source.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# Figure 3: final version (tile heatmap + combined bottom legend)
# ==============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# Asterisk colours
color_env_bridge <- "#800080" # purple (Environment)
color_health_bridge <- "#0000FF" # blue (Health)

# Combined marker mapping (for the bottom legend)
marker_shapes <- c("Expected (E->H)" = 19, 
                   "Reverse (H->E)"  = 17, 
                   "Env Bridge (*)"  = 8, 
                   "Health Bridge (*)" = 8)

marker_colors <- c("Expected (E->H)" = "#FFD700", 
                   "Reverse (H->E)"  = "#CD5C5C", 
                   "Env Bridge (*)"  = color_env_bridge, 
                   "Health Bridge (*)" = color_health_bridge)

message("\n========== Generating the tile version of Figure 3 ==========")

plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  model_label <- models[i]
  if(is.null(list_edges[[model_label]])) next
  
  df_curr <- list_edges[[model_label]] 
  clean_title <- gsub("_", " ", model_label)
  show_y_axis <- (i == 1)
  
  # Unify Y-axis levels
  df_curr$Source <- factor(df_curr$Source, levels = unified_y_levels)
  
  # Build a full grid so all cells align
  full_grid <- expand.grid(
    Target = unique(df_curr$Target),
    Source = unified_y_levels
  )
  
  # Drop rows with NA DAG status to avoid an NA in the legend
  df_dag <- subset(df_curr, !is.na(Direction_Type))
  if(nrow(df_dag) > 0) {
    df_dag$Direction_Type <- factor(df_dag$Direction_Type, levels = c("Expected (E->H)", "Reverse (H->E)"))
  }

  p <- ggplot() + 
    # 1. Checkerboard background (empty cells shown light grey)
    geom_tile(data = full_grid, aes(x = Target, y = Source), 
              fill = "grey95", color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
              
    # 2. Coloured data tiles
    geom_tile(data = df_curr, aes(x = Target, y = Source, fill = Freq), 
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
               
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#B22222", mid = "white", high = "#006400", 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.08, 0.08), oob = scales::squish, 
                         name = "Partial Correlation") +
    
    # 3. Values, 2 decimals, centred
    geom_text(data = df_curr, aes(x = Target, y = Source, label = sprintf("%.3f", Freq)), 
              size = 2.6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", 
              # white text on dark fills, black on light fills
              color = ifelse(abs(df_curr$Freq) > 0.059, "white", "black")) +
    
    # 4. Bridge-node markers (top-left / top-right of the tile)
    geom_point(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Env_Bridge), 
               aes(x = Target, y = Source, shape = "Env Bridge (*)", color = "Env Bridge (*)"), 
               size = 2, stroke = 0.8,
               position = position_nudge(x = -0.35, y = 0.35)) +
               
    geom_point(data = subset(df_curr, Is_Health_Bridge), 
               aes(x = Target, y = Source, shape = "Health Bridge (*)", color = "Health Bridge (*)"), 
               size = 2, stroke = 0.8,
               position = position_nudge(x = 0.35, y = 0.35)) +
    
    # 5. DAG direction marker (below the tile)
    geom_point(data = df_dag, aes(x = Target, y = Source, shape = as.character(Direction_Type)), 
               color = "black", size = 2.8, position = position_nudge(y = -0.35), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = df_dag, aes(x = Target, y = Source, shape = as.character(Direction_Type), color = as.character(Direction_Type)), 
               size = 1.6, position = position_nudge(y = -0.35)) +
               
    # Shared shape / colour mapping
    scale_shape_manual(values = marker_shapes, name = "Markers & DAG Direction", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = marker_colors, name = "Markers & DAG Direction", drop = FALSE) +
    
    # enlarge the asterisk in the legend
    guides(
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5, stroke = 0.8)),
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5, stroke = 0.8))
    ) +
    
    # 6. Axes and layout
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.0) + 
    scale_y_discrete(limits = unified_y_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 9, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis) element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black", face = "bold") else element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(title = clean_title)

  plot_list[[model_label]] <- p
}

# --- Step 3: Assemble panels + global legend ---
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  
  # Wrap panels and collect legends
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + 
                   plot_layout(guides = "collect")
  
  # Add title and global annotation
  final_plot <- combined_plot + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3: Direct Pathways and Causal Directions across Health Domains",
      caption = "Note: Cell color maps to partial correlation direction and strength. Grey cells indicate non-significant edges.",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0, color = "gray20"),
        # place the collected legend at the bottom, horizontal
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.margin = margin(t = 5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
      )
    )

  # Save
  out_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "Figure3_Ultimate_Fusion_Heatmap.pdf")
  ggsave(out_pdf, final_plot, width = 19, height = 9.5)
  
  print(final_plot)
  message(paste("Tile version saved to:", out_pdf))
  
} else {
  message("No data.")
}
```

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Figure 6: DAG summary (reads RDS directly)
# ==============================================================================
message("\n========== Generating Figure 6 (DAG summary) ==========")

list_dag_summary <- list()

for (model_label in models) {
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(bggm_file, row.names = 1))
  
  edges_bggm <- as.data.frame(as.table(adj_mat)) %>%
    filter(Freq != 0, abs(Freq) > 0.02) %>%
    rename(Node1 = Var1, Node2 = Var2) %>%
    mutate(
      Type1 = case_when(grepl("^E", Node1)~"E", grepl("^L", Node1)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Node1)~"H", TRUE~"O"),
      Type2 = case_when(grepl("^E", Node2)~"E", grepl("^L", Node2)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Node2)~"H", TRUE~"O")
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Key = paste(sort(c(as.character(Node1), as.character(Node2))), collapse = "|")) %>%
    ungroup() %>% distinct(Key, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- Read the RDS ---
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  dag_keys <- character()
  
  if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
    str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
    avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = DAG_THRESHOLD)
    dag_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
    if(nrow(dag_arcs) > 0){
      from_safe <- make.names(dag_arcs$from)
      to_safe   <- make.names(dag_arcs$to)
      dag_keys  <- paste0(from_safe, "->", to_safe)
    }
  }

classify_edge <- function(n1, n2, t1, t2) {
    s1 <- make.names(n1)
    s2 <- make.names(n2)

    if(setequal(c(t1,t2), c("E","L"))) { 
      p="E-L"; 
      exp=paste0(ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2)); 
      rev=paste0(ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2)) 
    }
    else if(setequal(c(t1,t2), c("L","H"))) { 
      p="L-H"; 
      exp=paste0(ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2)); 
      rev=paste0(ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="L",s1,s2)) 
    }
    else if(setequal(c(t1,t2), c("E","H"))) { 
      p="E-H"; 
      exp=paste0(ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2)); 
      rev=paste0(ifelse(t1=="H",s1,s2),"->",ifelse(t1=="E",s1,s2)) 
    }
    else return(NULL)
    
    stat <- "Undirected (BGGM Only)"
    if(exp %in% dag_keys) stat <- "Directed (Expected)"
    else if(rev %in% dag_keys) stat <- "Directed (Reverse)"
    return(data.frame(Domain=p, Status=stat))
}

  res_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:nrow(edges_bggm)) res_list[[i]] <- classify_edge(as.character(edges_bggm$Node1[i]), as.character(edges_bggm$Node2[i]), edges_bggm$Type1[i], edges_bggm$Type2[i])
  df_sum <- bind_rows(res_list)
  if(nrow(df_sum)>0) { df_sum$Model <- model_label; list_dag_summary[[model_label]] <- df_sum }
}

df_fig6 <- bind_rows(list_dag_summary)
if(nrow(df_fig6)>0) {
  p6 <- ggplot(df_fig6, aes(x=Domain, fill=Status)) +
    geom_bar(position="stack", width=0.6) +
    geom_text(stat='count', aes(label=after_stat(count)), position=position_stack(vjust=0.5), color="white", size=3) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, scales="free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("Directed (Expected)"="#2E8B57", "Directed (Reverse)"="#CD5C5C", "Undirected (BGGM Only)"="#A9A9A9")) +
    labs(title="Figure 6: Summary of Causal Directions", subtitle=paste0("Threshold: ", DAG_THRESHOLD, " (RDS Source)"), x="Domain Pair", y="Edge Count") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position="bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure6_DAG_Summary.pdf"), p6, width=12, height=8)
  print(p6)
  message("Figure 6 complete.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Figure 4: indirect pathways (reads RDS directly)
# ==============================================================================
message("\n========== Generating Figure 4 (indirect pathways) ==========")

list_indirect <- list()

for (model_label in models) {
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) next
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(bggm_file, row.names = 1))
  
  # --- Read the RDS ---
  rds_file <- file.path(out_dir_dag, paste0("Boot_Object_", model_label, ".rds"))
  dag_keys <- character()
  
  if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
    str_fit <- readRDS(rds_file)
    avg_dag <- averaged.network(str_fit, threshold = DAG_THRESHOLD)
    dag_arcs <- as.data.frame(avg_dag$arcs)
    if(nrow(dag_arcs) > 0){
      from_safe <- make.names(dag_arcs$from)
      to_safe   <- make.names(dag_arcs$to)
      dag_keys  <- paste0(from_safe, "->", to_safe)
    }
  }
  
  # Base edge list
  edges_bggm <- as.data.frame(as.table(adj_mat)) %>%
    filter(Freq != 0, abs(Freq) > 0.00) %>%
    mutate(Strength = abs(Freq)) %>%
    mutate(
      Type1 = case_when(grepl("^E", Var1)~"E", grepl("^L", Var1)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Var1)~"H", TRUE~"Other"),
      Type2 = case_when(grepl("^E", Var2)~"E", grepl("^L", Var2)~"L", grepl("^[MPS]", Var2)~"H", TRUE~"Other"))

path_EL <- edges_bggm %>%
    filter((Type1 == "E" & Type2 == "L") | (Type1 == "L" & Type2 == "E")) %>%
    mutate(S = ifelse(Type1=="E", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           T = ifelse(Type1=="L", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           Key = paste0(make.names(S), "->", make.names(T))) %>%  
    select(S, T, Strength, Key) %>% rename(E=S, L=T, Str1=Strength, Key1=Key)

path_LH <- edges_bggm %>%
    filter((Type1 == "L" & Type2 == "H") | (Type1 == "H" & Type2 == "L")) %>%
    mutate(S = ifelse(Type1=="L", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           T = ifelse(Type1=="H", as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
           Key = paste0(make.names(S), "->", make.names(T))) %>% 
    select(S, T, Strength, Key) %>% rename(L=S, H=T, Str2=Strength, Key2=Key)
  
  full_path <- inner_join(path_EL, path_LH, by = "L") %>%
    mutate(
      Conf1 = Key1 %in% dag_keys,
      Conf2 = Key2 %in% dag_keys,
      Validation = case_when(
        Conf1 & Conf2 ~ "Strong Chain (Both Steps DAG Verified)",
        Conf1 | Conf2 ~ "Partial Chain (One Step DAG Verified)",
        TRUE ~ "Associational Chain (BGGM Only)"),
      
      Width = (Str1 + Str2)/2,
      Model = model_label
    )
  list_indirect[[model_label]] <- full_path
}

df_indirect <- bind_rows(list_indirect)

if (nrow(df_indirect) > 0) {
  df_indirect_viz <- df_indirect %>% filter(Width > 0.00) 
  
  if(nrow(df_indirect_viz) > 0) {
    p4 <- ggplot(df_indirect_viz, aes(axis1 = E, axis2 = L, axis3 = H, y = Width)) +
      geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Validation), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_stratum(width = 1/6, fill = "grey95", color = "grey20") +
      geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2.5) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Environment", "Lifestyle Mediator", "Health Outcome"), expand = c(.05, .05)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Strong Chain (Both Steps DAG Verified)"="#2E8B57", 
                                   "Partial Chain (One Step DAG Verified)"="#EEB422", 
                                   "Associational Chain (BGGM Only)"="#B0C4DE")) +
      facet_wrap(~Model, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = "Figure 4: Indirect Pathways (E->L->H)", 
           subtitle = paste0("Threshold: ", DAG_THRESHOLD, " (RDS Source)"),
           fill = "Causal Evidence") +
      theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face="bold"))
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure4_Indirect_Alluvial.pdf"), p4, width = 16, height = 10)
    print(p4)
    message("Figure 4 complete.")
  }
} else {
  message("Figure 4 not produced: no qualifying pathways found.")
}

message("\nAll figures updated; direct-RDS mode complete.")



# ==============================================================================
# 🔍 Step 1: Linkage Diagnostic (Separate E-L and L-H Printing)
# ==============================================================================
message("\n========== Path diagnostics: E*L and L*H connectivity ==========")

library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)

process_diagnostic <- function(model_label) {
  # 1. Read the file
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Health_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) {
    message(paste("[", model_label, "] adjacency-matrix file not found"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(bggm_file, row.names = 1))
  edges <- as.data.frame(as.table(adj_mat)) %>%
    filter(Freq != 0) %>%
    mutate(Strength = abs(Freq), 
           V1 = trimws(as.character(Var1)), 
           V2 = trimws(as.character(Var2)))
  
  # Node-type classification
  get_type <- function(node) {
    case_when(
      grepl("^E", node) ~ "E",
      grepl("^L", node) ~ "L",
      grepl("^[MPS]", node) ~ "H",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  }

  # --- Handle the two groups separately ---
  
  # Group 1: E * L links
  p_el <- edges %>%
    filter((get_type(V1)=="E" & get_type(V2)=="L") | (get_type(V1)=="L" & get_type(V2)=="E")) %>%
    mutate(E = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="E", V1, V2), 
           L = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="L", V1, V2)) %>%
    select(E, L, Strength) %>%
    distinct()

  # Group 2: L * H links
  p_lh <- edges %>%
    filter((get_type(V1)=="L" & get_type(V2)=="H") | (get_type(V1)=="H" & get_type(V2)=="L")) %>%
    mutate(L = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="L", V1, V2), 
           H = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="H", V1, V2)) %>%
    select(L, H, Strength) %>%
    distinct()

  # --- Print diagnostics ---
  message(paste0("\n--- Model [", model_label, "] diagnostic report ---"))
  
  message(paste(">>> [E * L]:", nrow(p_el), "edges"))
  if(nrow(p_el) > 0) print(head(p_el, 10)) else message("!!! note: E*L is empty")
  
  message(paste("\n>>> [L * H]:", nrow(p_lh), "edges"))
  if(nrow(p_lh) > 0) print(head(p_lh, 10)) else message("!!! note: L*H is empty")

  # Merge
  if(nrow(p_el) > 0 && nrow(p_lh) > 0) {
    combined <- inner_join(p_el, p_lh, by = "L", suffix = c(".el", ".lh"), relationship = "many-to-many")
    message(paste("\nMerge OK:", nrow(combined), "complete E-L-H chains"))
    
    combined <- combined %>%
      mutate(Width = (Strength.el + Strength.lh) / 2, Model = model_label)
    return(combined)
  } else {
    message("\nMerge failed: one side had no data, no triads formed")
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Run diagnostics for the three models
results_diag <- lapply(c("Mental", "Physical", "Social"), process_diagnostic)
df_alluv <- bind_rows(results_diag)

# --- Plot (only if data exist) ---
if (!is.null(df_alluv) && nrow(df_alluv) > 0) {
  p_diag <- ggplot(df_alluv, aes(axis1 = E, axis2 = L, axis3 = H, y = Width)) +
    geom_alluvium(fill = "#D1D1D1", width = 1/12, alpha = 0.6, color = "white") +
    geom_stratum(width = 1/5, fill = "white", color = "grey30") +
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Environment", "Lifestyle", "Health"), expand = c(.1, .1)) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())
  
  ggsave("Figure4_Diagnostic_Wide.pdf", p_diag, width = 16, height = 8)
  message("\nDiagnostic figure saved: Figure4_Diagnostic_Wide.pdf")
} else {
  message("\nFinal dataset empty; nothing to plot.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 🌈 Figure 4: System Activation Map (Lodes Format for Independent Links)
# ==============================================================================
message("\n========== Generating the activation / feedback map ==========")

library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)

process_diagnostic <- function(model_label) {
  # 1. Read the file
  bggm_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("adj_matrix_BGGM_", model_label, "_Health_Pearson_Resid.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(bggm_file)) {
    message(paste("[", model_label, "] adjacency-matrix file not found"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  adj_mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(bggm_file, row.names = 1))
  edges <- as.data.frame(as.table(adj_mat)) %>%
    filter(Freq != 0) %>%
    mutate(Strength = abs(Freq), 
           V1 = trimws(as.character(Var1)), 
           V2 = trimws(as.character(Var2)))
  
  # Node-type classification
  get_type <- function(node) {
    case_when(
      grepl("^E", node) ~ "E",
      grepl("^L", node) ~ "L",
      grepl("^[MPS]", node) ~ "H",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  }

  # --- Handle the two groups separately ---
  p_el <- edges %>%
    filter((get_type(V1)=="E" & get_type(V2)=="L") | (get_type(V1)=="L" & get_type(V2)=="E")) %>%
    mutate(E = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="E", V1, V2), L = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="L", V1, V2)) %>%
    select(E, L, Strength) %>% distinct()

  p_lh <- edges %>%
    filter((get_type(V1)=="L" & get_type(V2)=="H") | (get_type(V1)=="H" & get_type(V2)=="L")) %>%
    mutate(L = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="L", V1, V2), H = ifelse(get_type(V1)=="H", V1, V2)) %>%
    select(L, H, Strength) %>% distinct()

  # --- Print diagnostics ---
  message(paste0("\n--- Model [", model_label, "] diagnostic report ---"))
  message(paste(">>> [E * L]:", nrow(p_el), "edges"))
  if(nrow(p_el) > 0) print(head(p_el, 3))
  message(paste(">>> [L * H]:", nrow(p_lh), "edges"))
  if(nrow(p_lh) > 0) print(head(p_lh, 3))

  # =========================================================================
  # Convert to long (lodes) form to avoid NA errors
  # =========================================================================
  df_long <- data.frame()

  # E-L flow: unique PathID per edge, pivot to long (E and L only)
  if(nrow(p_el) > 0) {
    el_long <- p_el %>%
      mutate(
        Evidence = ifelse(paste0(E, "->", L) %in% c("E5->L4", "E8->L16", "E8->L1", "E8->L3"),
                          "Confirmed Forward (M2)", "Associational (BGGM)"),
        Model = model_label,
        PathID = paste0(model_label, "_EL_", row_number())
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(E, L), names_to = "Axis", values_to = "Node") %>%
      select(Model, PathID, Axis, Node, Strength, Evidence)
    
    df_long <- bind_rows(df_long, el_long)
  }

  # L-H flow: unique PathID per edge, pivot to long (L and H only)
  if(nrow(p_lh) > 0) {
    rev_rules <- list(
      Mental = c("M8->L9", "M1->L9", "M3->L9"),
      Physical = c("P7->L9", "P5->L9", "P3->L4", "P2->L12"),
      Social = character(0)
    )[[model_label]]

    lh_long <- p_lh %>%
      mutate(
        Key_Fwd = paste0(L, "->", H),
        Key_Rev = paste0(H, "->", L),
        Evidence = case_when(
          Key_Fwd == "L4->P8" & model_label == "Physical" ~ "Confirmed Forward (M2)",
          Key_Rev %in% rev_rules ~ "Reverse Feedback (H -> L)",
          TRUE ~ "Associational (BGGM)"
        ),
        Model = model_label,
        PathID = paste0(model_label, "_LH_", row_number())
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(L, H), names_to = "Axis", values_to = "Node") %>%
      select(Model, PathID, Axis, Node, Strength, Evidence)
    
    df_long <- bind_rows(df_long, lh_long)
  }

  return(df_long)
}

# 1. Extract and combine
results_diag <- lapply(c("Mental", "Physical", "Social"), process_diagnostic)
df_alluv <- bind_rows(results_diag)

# --- Plot ---
if (!is.null(df_alluv) && nrow(df_alluv) > 0) {
  
  # Normalise axis order and evidence-type order
  df_alluv$Axis <- factor(df_alluv$Axis, levels = c("E", "L", "H"))
  df_alluv$Model <- factor(df_alluv$Model, levels = c("Mental", "Physical", "Social"))
  df_alluv$Evidence <- factor(df_alluv$Evidence, 
                              levels = c("Associational (BGGM)", 
                                         "Reverse Feedback (H -> L)", 
                                         "Confirmed Forward (M2)"))
  
  custom_colors <- c(
    "Confirmed Forward (M2)"    = "#2E8B57", # green (DAG-directed)
    "Reverse Feedback (H -> L)" = "#FF3030", # red (DAG feedback)
    "Associational (BGGM)"      = "#D1D1D1"  # light grey (BGGM association)
  )

  # Plot in long form (x, stratum, alluvium)
  p_diag <- ggplot(df_alluv, aes(x = Axis, stratum = Node, alluvium = PathID, y = Strength)) +
    # flows
    geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Evidence), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.75, color = "white") +
    # nodes
    geom_stratum(width = 1/5, fill = "white", color = "grey30") +
    # text
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
    # x axis
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Environment (E)", "Lifestyle (L)", "Health (H)"), expand = c(.1, .1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(
      title = "Figure 4: System Activation Map (Independent Pathways)",
      subtitle = "Visualizing E->L nudges and L<->H feedback as distinct flow systems",
      fill = "Structural Evidence",
      y = "BGGM Partial Correlation Strength"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure4_Activation_Map.pdf"), p_diag, width = 16, height = 9)
  message("\nFigure saved: Figure4_Activation_Map.pdf")
} else {
  message("\nFinal dataset empty; nothing to plot.")
}
```
